entries.mechanism: Handler locks/reloads message with FOR NO KEY UPDATE NOWAIT, calls handler with the same database client and marks processed inside executeTransaction. Started/finished attempt differences inform poison handling.
entries.data_consistency: Same-client database effects and processed marker share transaction; external side effects cannot become atomic merely by invoking a callback here.
entries.failure_handling: Timeout callback checks transactionFinished before rollback/release; tests assert late timeout must not release a client again or roll back after completion. No handler can lead to marking complete.
entries.limitations: Unit tests use client mocks; real multi-process integration not run. Setup exporter includes DROP TABLE CASCADE, so it must never be used on existing local stores. README exactly-once claim narrowed to actual same-transaction effects.
entries.license: MIT LICENSE.md retrieved/read.

entries.mechanism: HTTP202 stages Mongo command+pending receipt; worker consumes validated command into PG receipt/ledger/balance/result outbox transaction; Mongo result inbox/projection confirms only matching causation/digest/request; claims use ownership tokens.
entries.data_consistency: Separate per-store transactions with durable bridge and result, not cross-store atomic commit. PG consumer reuses same db in inbound ledger transaction.
entries.failure_handling: Commit uncertainty preserves request identity; expired claims recover under token conditions; invalid/conflicting work held, dependencies retry, attempt exhaustion handled. Sequence gaps retry rather than silently advancing checkpoint.
entries.limitations: Test assertions read for queued/no-stock-before-commit, injected commit loss duplicate replay, projection duplicate and expired/fair claim recovery; not executed in this research. Full route permission policy and hosted topology remain unverified.
